build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package using setup.py with cmake for C++ extensions
create_cmake_extension: create a CMakeExtension class to define C++ extensions without Python source files
build_cmake_extension: build a single CMake extension module by configuring and running cmake with platform-specific flags
run_cmake_build: run the CMake build process that validates cmake version and builds all extensions
load_readme_description: load the README.md file content to use as the package long description in setup
